report: 根据噪声残留和JPEG压缩历史的测量结果，图像可能为生成图像，但现有工具无法提供足够的证据来确定其真实性。

evidence.phenomenon: Whole-image noise-residual level 0.8277: the generated-imagery end of the G2 calibration band. Variance collapse detected; a band is an association measured on the calibration set, not a physical proof of origin.
evidence.reasoning: Whole-image residual micro-noise level 0.8277 (low). The G2 calibration set associates this band with generated imagery (fake median 2.0 vs real median 3.6). The number is one statistic of the whole image and says nothing about where in the image anything is. Denoising, sharpening and re-compression move it the same way, so on its own it is a weak signal, not proof of origin.
evidence.interpretation_text: Calibration: this measurement band corresponds to generated-source statistics (P(Fake)=0.85); the generative reading applies.
evidence.counter_explanation: 该指标衡量残差水平而非"不一致性"：G2 校准（格式配平，5 格）显示 Real 中位数 3.6 对 Fake 2.0，方向与原始"异常即伪造"的解释相反，且跨格式稳定（AUROC 0.15-0.23）。降噪、锐化与重压缩同样会改变该水平，故只应作为弱证据与校准似然配合使用。
evidence.applicability_conditions: 高 strength 统计上对应 Real（JPEG 压缩引入方差），不得按 AI-generated 解读；低 strength 侧（P(Fake)≈0.8）可作为弱证据使用。
evidence.interpretation_text_raw: Low residual micro-noise level — smooth, low-variance output of the kind the calibration set associates with generated imagery.

evidence.phenomenon: JPEG structural analysis reveals DCT coefficient histogram hollowing. (blockiness: 1.0390, DCT anomaly: 4.3236)
evidence.reasoning: Moderate JPEG structure found (blockiness=1.0390, DCT anomaly=4.3236). This is the weaker end of the calibration band: the same structure appears when an already-compressed image is re-saved, and at low quality (≤ 70) the band loses its discriminative power almost entirely, so it should not drive a verdict on its own. Whether the band is decisive here depends on the cell the calibration table records for this input, which is attached to the token.
evidence.interpretation_text: Calibration: this measurement band is near chance (P(Fake)=0.45) and does not determine a direction.
evidence.counter_explanation: 本指标衡量"是否存在 JPEG 压缩历史"而非伪造痕迹：G2 校准显示高值倾向 Real（PNG 格分离度 0.972、native 0.962，但重压缩至 q70 后降至 0.569），即它主要反映来源的压缩历史。统一重压缩后的图像上该证据近乎无效，不得作为独立判据。
evidence.applicability_conditions: 高 strength 统计上对应 Real（原生 JPEG 照片）；q70 配平后分离度仅 0.57。仅当来源无压缩历史时可反向参考。
evidence.interpretation_text_raw: Intermediate JPEG structural level; this band is near the calibrated chance level, and re-compression weakens it further.
